title: Leather notepad illustration, 2013
lede: A Photoshop drawing of a stitched leather notepad with ruled paper and a pen, made to illustrate skeuomorphism.
summary: Stitched brown leather, ruled paper, a chrome pen, and gold script. Openly licensed, 2013.

evidence.note: Inspected the full 687 × 1108 px original from Wikimedia Commons. It is an amateur demonstration, not a shipped interface.

styles.note: Shows the full vocabulary of the style in one image: leather grain, stitching, ruled paper, a photoreal pen, and embossed gold type. It is a demonstration, not a historical product.

context: The Commons description: “This is a leather notepad created in photoshop. It includes a pen, paper, and gold embroidery. This is a classic example of skeuomorphism: making a simulation of a real life object.” [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Leather_Notepad.png).
observed: A brown leather cover with a fine grain and a lighter dashed stitch line inset from the edges and along a pocket seam.
A sheet of white paper with pale blue horizontal rules, a red margin rule on each side, and punched holes along the left edge.
A silver and dark gray pen with strong highlights lies over the paper and casts a shadow.
The word “Notes” in gold italic script with a dark drop shadow sits on the leather pocket.
interpretation: The image repeats the iOS and Lion notepad vocabulary (see [Notes](ref:ios-notes-legal-pad)) without any interface controls, so its measurements show material color and texture alone.
borrow: Mark a panel edge with a dashed stitch line 6 to 10 px inside the border, in a lighter tone of the leather.
Use a red margin rule and pale blue rules for a note surface.

images.alt: A brown stitched leather notepad holding a sheet of ruled white paper, with a silver pen clipped at the top left and the word Notes in gold script on the lower pocket.
